structured_output.what_is_happening: Nasdaq4200 is a 15-minute-old pump.fun coin that has already moved to PumpSwap (GMGN shows created and migrated at the same timestamp). Market cap is about $101k with $27.7k in liquidity. It has done $214k of volume in about 15 minutes, which is 7.7 times its market cap. The buy/sell counts are very lopsided: 3,547 buys against 356 sells, and 3,227 unique buyers against 140 unique sellers. The average buy is only about $60. Even so, price has fallen from its high of about $175k market cap: GeckoTerminal shows -32% over 15 minutes and -13% over 5 minutes. So a few large sells are absorbing thousands of tiny buys. About 3,300 holders are very evenly spread: top 10 hold 4.4%, each holding 0.38–0.50%. That is unusually flat for a 15-minute coin, and it fits holder-inflation or micro-buy bots rather than organic accumulation. The dev holds nothing and has closed out ('creator_close'). The coin is flagged as a community takeover, and its DexScreener profile was updated. Mint and freeze authority are renounced, LP is burned, and RugCheck shows no risks.
